seo.title: FAQ | Jeff & Paige
seo.description: Frequently asked questions about Jeff and Paige's wedding — dress code, parking, hotel block, kids policy, registry, after party, and more.
seo.social_description: Everything you need to know about the wedding weekend — dress code, parking, hotels, after party, and more.

hero.label: We've Got Answers
hero.title: FAQ
hero.subtitle: Can't find what you're looking for? Email us at

questions.question: What is the dress code?
questions.answer:
Cocktail and Semi-Formal Attire. Please no jeans. 

The after party is more relaxed — feel free to change into something more comfortable.

questions.question: Is parking available at the venue?
questions.answer: Valet parking is available on site! When you arrive, drive up to the first barn and the HollyHedge team will be there to assist you.

questions.question: Are children welcome at the wedding?
questions.answer: We love your little ones! Details on whether children are included will be noted with your invitation. If you have any questions, please reach out to us at [jeffandpaigeplanning@gmail.com](mailto:jeffandpaigeplanning@gmail.com).

questions.question: Where are you registered? Can I bring a gift to the wedding?
questions.answer: We haven't set up a registry yet — if we do, we'll share it on our [Registry page](registry.html).

questions.question: Is there a hotel room block for guests?
questions.answer:
HollyHedge has rooms on-site for booking! Breakfast is included with all booked rooms. More details on the room block will be provided soon. 

 Visit our [Travel page](travel.html) for updates.

questions.question: What time should I arrive?
questions.answer: More details about the ceremony time will be provided soon.

questions.question: Will the ceremony be indoors or outdoors?
questions.answer: Outdoors! The ceremony will be held outside on the grounds of HollyHedge Estate, weather permitting. We'll confirm the indoor rain backup plan with HollyHedge Estate closer to the date.

questions.question: Can I take photos and post on social media?
questions.answer: We are having an **unplugged ceremony** — please keep phones and cameras away during the ceremony so our photographer can capture the moment and so you can be fully present. After the ceremony, photos are warmly encouraged! Feel free to share with **#PaigetookaGander**.

questions.question: I have a food allergy or dietary restriction. Will you accommodate me?
questions.answer: Absolutely. Please note your dietary restrictions in the RSVP form and we will do our best to accommodate you. If you have a serious allergy, please also email us directly at [jeffandpaigeplanning@gmail.com](mailto:jeffandpaigeplanning@gmail.com) so we can coordinate with the catering team.

questions.question: Can I bring a plus one?
questions.answer: Plus ones are noted on your invitation. Due to venue capacity, we are unable to accommodate additional guests beyond what is listed on your invitation. If you have questions, please reach out to us directly.

questions.question: Is there an after party?
questions.answer: Yes — and all guests are welcome! After the reception, the party continues in the **Stone Barn** at HollyHedge Estate from **11:00 PM to 1:00 AM**. Kick off your heels, loosen your tie, and join us for a more casual close to the evening.

questions.question: I still have a question. How do I get in touch?
questions.answer: We'd love to hear from you! Email us at [jeffandpaigeplanning@gmail.com](mailto:jeffandpaigeplanning@gmail.com) or send us a text and we'll get back to you as soon as possible. For day-of emergencies, contact information for the wedding coordinator will be shared with all RSVP'd guests closer to the date.

cta.title: Still Have Questions?
cta.text: Drop us a line and we'll get back to you quickly.
